sentences.text: 4 15-05-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioners have renewed his prayer for grant of regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 366(A), 376(D), 506, 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4/6 POCSO Act, which was earlier rejected vide order dated 11.9.2023 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 48261 of 2023 with a direction to trial court to expedite and conclude the trial.

3. In compliance of order dated 13.03.2024, a progress report dated 19.03.2024 sent by learned Exclusive Spl. Judge (POCSO) Darbhanga has been received to this Court which suggests that trial is likely to be concluded within two Patna High Court CR.
4. As the trial is likely to be concluded in near future, learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw this bail application.
